entities.title: Police Radio Resources
entities.description: References for understanding agency call signs and radio IDs heard in AFPD recordings.

sections.title: Agency call signs
sections.description: Agency call signs identify a jurisdiction or agency in a spoken radio exchange. For example, 5J refers to American Fork, 7J to Pleasant Grove, and 8J to Lehi.

sources.title: Utah State Agency Radio Call Identifiers
sources.description: Look up agency call identifiers throughout Utah, including Utah County’s J identifiers.

sources.title: Utah County radio reference
sources.description: Local reference for agency call signs, law enforcement coverage, and other Utah County radio information.

sections.title: Radio-ID references
sections.description: A numeric radio ID identifies a transmitting radio. It is distinct from a spoken agency call sign and from a talkgroup, which identifies a radio channel or conversation group.

sources.title: AFPD radio IDs and named response days
sources.description: Spreadsheet of transcript-based officer-name associations, named response examples, dates, and links to the recordings. Includes Findings, Exchanges, Exceptions, and Coverage tabs.
sources.note: Audio was not reviewed for this collation. Named replies and repeated patterns do not establish who transmitted every recording under an ID.

sources.title: Utah Communications Authority P25 RID/UID Reference
sources.description: Background on numeric radio IDs and agency ID ranges in Utah’s P25 system.

entities.attributionNote: Repeated recorded exchanges can strongly associate a radio ID with an officer. Attributing a particular statement to that officer still requires further confirmation.
